salary_details.details: In addition to the remuneration indicated above, a consolidated amount of Rs. 12,000/- per year will be paid towards expenses like insurance premium, attire allowance, stitching charges, footwear allowance, etc. Project Engineers who complete an overall tenure of 4 years will be entitled to a Retention Bonus of Rs. 25,000/- for every completed year (payable at the end of 4 years i.e., Rs. 1,00,000/-). followed by an Interview for those who qualify in the Written Test. 85% marks will be allotted for the written test and 15% marks for the interview. Candidates who pass the written test will be called for interview in the ratio of 1:5 in order of merit in each role in each category.

important_instructions: Project Engineers are appointed initially for a period of three years, extendable up to a maximum of one more year (maximum tenure of 4 years). Lateral application for the same post (e.g., existing Project Engineer applying for Project Engineer) is not permitted and will be summarily rejected. Candidates working in PSUs/Govt. organizations must submit a No Objection Certificate at the time of application or interview. Selected candidates are required to obtain a Medical Insurance cover for Rs. 2 lakhs per annum and Life Cover Insurance for Rs. 5 lakhs per annum at the time of joining. Applications received in any format other than online will not be considered. No cheque, DD, or cash will be accepted towards application fee payment.

content_sections.heading: BEL Project Engineer-I Vacancy Details (Discipline-wise)
content_sections.text: There are a total of 14 vacancies for the Project Engineer-I post.

content_sections.heading: BEL Project Engineer-I Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Only Indian nationals need apply. Disciplines and subjects defined: Computer Science: Computer Science / Computer Science & Engineering / Computer Science Engineering. Electronics: Electronics / Electronics & Communication / Electronics & Telecommunication / Communication / Telecommunication. Relevant post-qualification industry experience as on 01.10.2026 should be more than two years. Teaching/Academic/Research work, banking and financial institutions, non-profit organizations, and internship placements which are part of academic curriculum will not be considered as experience.

rows.qualification_required: Full time B.E. / B.Tech / B.Sc Engineering (4-year course) with PASS CLASS from a recognized University/Institution in the relevant discipline.

content_sections.heading: BEL Project Engineer-I Age Limit
content_sections.text: The upper age limit as on 01.10.2026 is 32 years for General & EWS category candidates.

rows.relaxation: 10 years (having minimum 40% disability, in addition to relaxation applicable to OBC/SC/ST)

content_sections.heading: BEL Project Engineer-I Salary
content_sections.text: In addition to the remuneration indicated above, a consolidated amount of Rs. 12,000/- per year will be paid towards expenses like insurance premium, attire allowance, stitching charges, footwear allowance, etc. Project Engineers who complete an overall tenure of 4 years will be entitled to a Retention Bonus of Rs. 25,000/- for every completed year (payable at the end of 4 years i.e., Rs. 1,00,000/-). Gratuity is admissible as per BEL Employees Gratuity Scheme rules.

rows.pay_level_pay: An all-inclusive consolidated remuneration of Rs. 50,000/- per month for the 1st Year of engagement & an increase of Rs. 5,000/- for every extension of contract.

content_sections.heading: BEL Project Engineer-I Application Fee
content_sections.text: The application fee must be remitted through SBI Collect (online mode) or by approaching an SBI branch. Fee once paid will not be refunded.

rows.fee: Exempted from payment of application fee

content_sections.heading: BEL Project Engineer-I Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection will be through a Written Test for shortlisted candidates, followed by an Interview for those who qualify in the Written Test. 85% marks will be allotted for the written test and 15% marks for the interview. Candidates who pass the written test will be called for interview in the ratio of 1:5 in order of merit in each role in each category.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for BEL Project Engineer-I
content_sections.text: Go to the official website at https://jobapply.in/BEL2026BNGEWAPE. Fill in the necessary fields through the online format. Submit the application form by clicking submit. Print the application form duly filled in all aspects. Remit the application fee of Rs. 400/- plus 18% GST through SBI Collect using the specified payment category and note the SBI Collect reference number. Enter the SBI Collect reference number in the application form where required. Carry the printout of the filled application form with 2 recent passport-size colour photographs and relevant mandatory documents to the selection centre on the day of selections.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: SSLC/SSC/ISC/10th Standard marks card (as proof of date of birth) All certificates starting from Matriculation/Class X in support of educational qualifications B.E/B.Tech degree certificate (as applicable) All semester Marks Sheets / Final consolidated marks sheet Caste / Community / Disability / Income certificate in prescribed format (if applicable) Post-qualification experience certificates from previous till current employer, along with joining/appointment letter and relieving letter (or first and latest pay slip and employee ID proof if current employment experience certificate is not produced) No Objection Certificate (if working in PSUs / Govt. organizations) Intimation Letter (if currently working as Trainee Engineer in BEL) Copy of the Application fee payment receipt (SBI receipt)

content_sections.heading: BEL Project Engineer-I Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Project Engineers are appointed initially for a period of three years, extendable up to a maximum of one more year (maximum tenure of 4 years). Lateral application for the same post (e.g., existing Project Engineer applying for Project Engineer) is not permitted and will be summarily rejected. Candidates working in PSUs/Govt. organizations must submit a No Objection Certificate at the time of application or interview. Selected candidates are required to obtain a Medical Insurance cover for Rs. 2 lakhs per annum and Life Cover Insurance for Rs. 5 lakhs per annum at the time of joining. Applications received in any format other than online will not be considered. No cheque, DD, or cash will be accepted towards application fee payment.

faq.question: Q1. What is BEL Project Engineer-I Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment notification released by Bharat Electronics Limited (BEL) for hiring Project Engineer-I posts on a temporary basis for the Electronic Warfare & Avionics SBU at Bengaluru Complex.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in BEL Project Engineer-I Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 14 vacancies, comprising 8 for Electronics and 6 for Computer Science.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply online for BEL Project Engineer-I?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 23 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for BEL Project Engineer-I?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a full-time B.E. / B.Tech / B.Sc Engineering (4-year course) with a pass class from a recognized University or Institution in Electronics or Computer Science disciplines.

faq.question: Q5. What is the upper age limit for BEL Project Engineer-I posts?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 32 years as on 01.10.2026 for General and EWS candidates, with relaxations for reserved categories as per government guidelines.
